summary: Tested A1/A2/A3 (dashboard secondary panel + Bureau per-role config + per-user persistence) and B (spacing/typography no-regression on /profile, /members). Backend: 6/6 pytest OK on /api/dashboard/layout, PUT /api/account/dashboard, GET/PUT /api/settings/dashboard (403 for membre & pro confirmed). Frontend: for membre1/pro3/admin the priority blocks render immediately, [data-testid=dashboard-secondary] + toggle exist, toggle expands/collapses [data-testid=dashboard-secondary-content], PUT persists (verified via reload = state stays), Bureau card + 4 role switches (PARTICULIER/PROFESSIONNEL/PRO_COORDINATEUR/ADMIN_BUREAU) + save button all present and save action succeeds without error. /profile and /members load with no console errors. Cleanup: role defaults left at all TRUE, membre1 pref reset to secondary_open=true.

results_per_item.A1_secondary_panel_all_roles: OK — membre1, pro3, admin all show priority blocks + dashboard-secondary + dashboard-secondary-toggle. Toggle shows/hides dashboard-secondary-content.
results_per_item.A2_per_user_preference_persists: OK — PUT /account/dashboard {secondary_open:false} persists across reload for membre1 (verified via reload + GET /dashboard/layout).
results_per_item.A3_bureau_config: OK — /admin/settings shows dashboard-blocks-card with dashboard-role-switch-{PARTICULIER,PROFESSIONNEL,PRO_COORDINATEUR,ADMIN_BUREAU} + dashboard-blocks-save. Non-admin PUT/GET => 403 (pytest).
results_per_item.B_spacing_typography: OK — /profile, /members, dashboards render without layout breakage or console errors.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /dashboard/layout: default_open resolves from app_settings.dashboard_secondary.roles[user.role] with True fallback; user preference overrides when not null. Correct precedence.

server.py PUT /account/dashboard: casts to bool(payload.get('secondary_open')) — accepts truthy/falsy correctly, no validation model but acceptable for a single-bool endpoint. Consider Pydantic model for strictness.

SecondaryPanel.jsx: initial open state = null, renders nothing until API resolves — avoids flicker but silently swallows PUT errors (.catch(()=>{})). User gets no feedback if persistence fails; consider a toast on failure.
DashboardBlocksSettings.jsx: no dirty-tracking; Save always PUTs even without changes. Not blocking.

UI: the login 'Bienvenue !' toast (top-right) can overlap SecondaryPanel toggle on first render — first click may be intercepted. Consider auto-dismissing the welcome toast or ensuring z-index/positioning does not cover interactive dashboard content.
seed_data_creation: None. Cleanup performed: 4 role defaults reset to TRUE via PUT /api/settings/dashboard; membre1 preference reset to secondary_open=true via PUT /api/account/dashboard.
